title: Safer hand — Dental Flower Studio
question: The familiar end of the spectrum: three grounded directions and the category standard. Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The Florist's Studio
options.lineage: boutique flower studios: tissue wrap, a hand-tied ribbon, a handwritten tag
options.thesis: The visit is arranged for you the way a florist ties a bouquet: chosen, wrapped and named.
options.viewport: A blush tissue field with a large studio wordmark, a white florist tag with the owner's welcome line, and a ribbon-red 'Запиши час' button.
options.risk: This is where most beauty-studio sites land; it stays distinct only if the green carries real weight and the tag voice is personal.

options.label: The Flower Mark
options.lineage: Swiss modernist pharmaceutical posters (Geigy-style grid and a single mark)
options.thesis: One geometric flower mark and a strict grid: precise care, rendered calmly.
options.viewport: The top half is a rose-colour field holding a giant five-petal mark; the bottom half is a white grid with the headline, a short intro and the booking action.
options.risk: Clean and confident, but it can read corporate if the owner's voice doesn't come through in the copy.

options.label: Your Smile, Charted
options.lineage: the dental chart (odontogram) and a written treatment plan
options.thesis: The individual treatment plan made visible: a calm, beautiful chart of 32 teeth as the page's signature.
options.viewport: The headline sits beside a large, finely drawn tooth chart with a few rose marks, captioned 'Всеки план е индивидуален'.
options.risk: It is the most clinical of the three; it needs warm copy and the rose accent so it doesn't feel like a medical form.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A design-forward dental studio site in the vein of Tend or Dentologie, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A soft hero headline, a booking button, a row of service cards and a studio photo strip.
canonCard.risk: It depends on professional photography the studio doesn't have, and it looks like everyone else.
